candidate_practices.name: Name the changed assumption and surviving dependency
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts specify the target, arithmetic, resource, or complexity qualification behind their advance.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this makes novelty assessable without relying on priority language.
candidate_practices.application: Rewrite the advance as a change from a specified prior condition, immediately naming remaining requirements.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not invent a removed assumption when the contribution improves behavior within unchanged conditions.

support.specific_example: HALO certifies policy-learning stability, distinct from trajectory safety.
Floating-point arithmetic changes expressivity results; restricted domains change bounds.
Approximate-score sampling has polylogarithmic inverse-accuracy dependence, with dimension entering through effective radius.
Word-level alignment is removed, but sentence-level alignment remains.

contrasts.contrast: Joint partner-environment selection adds capability conditional on a procedural generator.
The clipping-rate improvement is specifically two-objective; Pareto-critical convergence is a different guarantee.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Exact assumptions, definitions, and whether guarantees cover reported operating settings.

candidate_practices.name: Explain component responsibilities before listing modules
candidate_practices.source_observation: Architectural summaries assign different components distinct representational, verification, routing, or temporal roles.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: role assignments can explain why multiple contributions belong together.
candidate_practices.application: Replace an acronym list with component → operation → intended responsibility sentences.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not imply independently established component effects from design intentions alone.

support.specific_example: Instance latents, sparse global factors, and amortized inference serve different roles.
Perception verification, scalable verbal verification, and credit routing address separate tasks.
Shared, task-specific, and dynamic experts accompany task-discriminability training.
Long-horizon encoding complements phase-conditioned execution alignment.

contrasts.contrast: Structural polarity handling and Fourier extraction need operational explanation, not an invented one-to-one causal diagnosis.
Fairness components become constraints rather than architectural modules.
Unified vision-motion codes organize three training stages; a stage-based account may fit better.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Component interactions, operational definitions, and evidence separating individual contributions.

candidate_practices.name: Connect a diagnostic finding to a targeted change
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts move from localized structure or failure patterns to selective interventions and outcomes.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: the sequence makes the proposed explanation testable without treating diagnosis as causation.
candidate_practices.application: State what was measured, what was selectively changed, and which outcome followed; preserve evidential distinctions.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Descriptive findings need not include interventions unavailable within the study.

support.specific_example: Spectral analysis accompanies importance-based head-update removal and rewinding.
Influence attribution leads to targeted data changes compared with random interventions.
Differentiated head roles are accompanied by ablations and persistent-activation detection.
Low-entropy symbolic errors motivate targeted reasoning-preservation training.

contrasts.contrast: The response to exploration collapse removes order flexibility rather than adding a component.
Compression regularization receives a formal error-bound account, not the same intervention narrative.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Alternative explanations, intervention comparability, and whether diagnostic signals causally explain outcomes.

candidate_practices.name: Bound rankings by the comparison design
candidate_practices.source_observation: Study abstracts specify shared frameworks, capability categories, or distribution shifts before comparative conclusions.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: readers can distinguish a conditional design recommendation from a universal winner.
candidate_practices.application: Place the common setting and varied factor before the ranking; retain task-dependent findings.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Complete deployment systems may require comparisons with different architectures and budgets.

support.specific_example: Four memory categories and 14 backbone-based variants accompany task-dependent findings.
Decoder-only diffusion addresses architecture confounding in paradigm comparisons.
Four strategies share a VLA baseline; formulation advantages differ by capability.
Generalist claims specify unseen fine-tuned activations and training-diversity variation.

contrasts.contrast: CAT-Q compares different model sizes and training regimes; its resource comparison does not establish factor isolation.
A newly defined visual threat motivates a dedicated benchmark and model-specific rates.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Controlled factors, benchmark validity, task coverage, and comparability of reported rankings.

candidate_practices.name: Give each formal transformation its own consequence
candidate_practices.source_observation: Theory abstracts connect representations to computational properties, inherited cases, or derived variants.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: readers can identify which result supports which part of a broader framework.
candidate_practices.application: Write transformation → consequence pairs; distinguish recovery, extension, relaxation, and final output.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: A single theorem need not be split into artificial intermediate contributions.

support.specific_example: MMOT yields a polynomial LP; fractional bridge output templates a reduced integral LP.
OENN generalization accompanies map characterization and approximation results covering graph and sheaf models.
Dependent categorical ANOVA recovers independence and supports a SHAP generalization.
Isotropic posteriors recover SVRG; broader choices yield algorithmic variants.

contrasts.contrast: Information-exponent convergence, negative initialization, and RKHS implementation are distinct results, not necessarily a derivation chain.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Exact inclusion relations, derivations, theorem conditions, and implementation correspondence.

candidate_practices.name: Report efficiency with its preserved outcome and denominator
candidate_practices.source_observation: Systems abstracts pair resource claims with quality, feasibility, or comparator conditions.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: paired reporting identifies the practical trade-off being claimed.
candidate_practices.application: Attach hardware, comparator, budget, and preserved outcome to each efficiency statement when available.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not translate proxy counts into runtime or omit unavailable measurement qualifications.

support.specific_example: SDXL W4A4 gains 1.2 PSNR over SVDQuant with under 0.5% added time.
Long-form benchmark comparisons accompany a per-query cost claim.
Single-H100 training feasibility accompanies retained properties and AdamW memory failure.
Alternative execution programs pair accuracy with executed-layer counts.

contrasts.contrast: Limited-feedback performance is stated without label budgets; no numerical efficiency ratio follows.
Fewer steering interventions measure intervention frequency, not necessarily wall-clock savings.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Accounting boundaries, runtime protocols, aggregate definitions, and retained-quality measurements.

candidate_practices.name: Separate a position's thesis, evidence, and requested action
candidate_practices.source_observation: Position abstracts connect arguments or empirical diagnoses to community responses with different scopes.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: separating these elements exposes where evidence ends and prescription begins.
candidate_practices.application: State the proposed action, identify its supporting evidence type, and name remaining prerequisites.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: A narrow technical result need not become a deployment recommendation.

support.specific_example: Institutional-influence arguments and impact review precede collective-action proposals.
Review comparisons and rewriting tests support evaluation demands; necessary criteria remain insufficient.
Human collaboration, process-data requirements, and illustrative studies define an assistance agenda.
Possible and reported alignment misuse are mapped before mitigation proposals.

contrasts.contrast: Pricing prescriptions combine formal incentives and a heuristic demonstration; this differs from an unvalidated ecosystem agenda.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Argument sources, causal support, proposal feasibility, and the scope of apparent disagreement.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Pair a bound with empirical tightness and a surprising scope condition.
unusual_but_useful.application: Separate scaling law, observed bound gap, and unbounded-resource claim.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Accessibility and the reported factor require definitions.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Distinguish acquired bias from inherited bias.
unusual_but_useful.application: Explain why artificial equal-status groups probe experience-based stratification.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Do not generalize the mechanism beyond the studied setting.

unusual_but_useful.application: Place the additional coalition condition beside fairness and truthfulness claims.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Relaxations need not preserve every guarantee.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Treat reproducibility infrastructure as a measured contribution.
unusual_but_useful.application: Separate signed result deviation, code reuse, and standardized coverage.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Mean signed deviation can hide offsetting errors.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Define benchmark capability through adversary access and boundary conditions.
unusual_but_useful.application: Distinguish shell access, nested layers, and added vulnerabilities.
unusual_but_useful.limit: No-known-vulnerability wording establishes neither invulnerability nor unrestricted escape.

unusual_but_useful.application: Report recovery after finetuning alongside initial performance loss.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Recovery alone does not establish retained internal knowledge.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Name the measurable proxy behind a broad trust claim.
unusual_but_useful.application: Connect token-flow measures to the actual AUROC target.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Grounding and discrimination do not establish universal reliability or calibration.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Every abstract needs an ORAL-shaped method-and-experiment story.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Formal derivations, resources, empirical findings, and positions support different contribution structures.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: More flexibility or larger models necessarily improve outcomes.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Order flexibility, adaptive layer execution, and model-scale stratification have different reported consequences.

source_checks_needed.issue: Extraction contains a null character before pi_0; verify original spelling.
High-latency first-stage wording is stronger than the contribution summary; verify.
Matched random controls are an inferred recommendation; extraction only states random interventions.
A controlled factorial crossing is not established by taxonomy and variant counts.
Verify percentage versus percentage-point meaning and cost-accounting basis.
Verify calibration-token denominator and whether pretrained-model training costs are excluded.
Clarify flag location, vulnerable layer, and outer-layer protection.
Identify the asymptotic variable and hidden dimension dependence.
